description: Export the firm's records and documents to a downloadable copy: books, invoices, contacts, inventory, labor, and the filing cabinet. Returns links to a script that downloads it.

include.description: Narrow the export to these tables, by their exact names: accounting-ledger, accounting-balances, accounting-pending, invoicing-invoices (its lines ride with it), invoicing-transitions, invoicing-agreements, contacts, inventory-items, inventory-movements, labor-time-entries, labor-worker, labor-worker-legal, settings, rules-instances, rules-params, calendar-events, notes, tasks, assets, agreements, treasury-agreements, purchasing-orders, shipping, payments-webhook-log, payments-dlq, payments-dlq-bodies, inbox-inbound, agent-chats, agent-email. A name not on this list is refused with the list. Leave empty to take everything, which is the usual case; name tables only when someone wants a smaller copy.

resume.description: Continue an export that ran out of time, by its export id. Work already finished is not redone.

credentials_only.description: Refresh the download links for the most recent export instead of making a new one. Use when the previous links expired.
